answer: Meadow spiral beacon-decay bond: each agent tends a meadow, locks 70 credits, and each epoch the zephyr beacon posts wind data. The agent files a sealed spiral reading within 5% of the beacon data; a missed or copied filing decays the bond by 10. Filings cost 35; the kth 35+5(k-1); 1,000 forgeries pay 2,532,500 plus 70,000 locked for a 40,000 pool. Rented plots fail: one transect, one plot only. A truthful filer pays 35 once, keeps its bond.
